Coin silver can be found in antique shops, flea markets, & even yard sales. If you are buying coins vs. bullion be sure you pay as close to spot price as possible. The above link breaks down all US coins and there are other sites which break down Canadian & foreign coins. The point is you need to determine how much ASW is in the coin you are buying. Then price it and decide if the asking price is fair relative to current spot price.

I built an .xls spreadsheet that lets me immediately check price to determine if the ask hits my target. I set my limit at 20% over spot and that can usually be brought way down if you are buying more. Antique shops, fleas & yard sales are generally casual markets for coins. Although you do find sellers that specialize in them, for the most part people barely check out current values and if they do will negotiate on that price. I have found many foreign silver coins priced 50%-75% under spot at these places.

Good luck and good hunting!
